title: Em’s Server Utils
description: A utility mod to add some helpful commands to control usernames and their visibility.
body:
Em's Server Utils provides an extensive API for managing and changing player usernames and visibility. It's used in a few of my other mods.

In addition, it provides the following commands:

- /icon - add an icon to the player's username
- /nick - change the player's username
- /vanish - hide the player in the tab menu

An example of /icon:

![An example of an icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd8406b306d0bd8f38052da2d804968bd90e40c3.png)

An example of /nick:

![A nickname](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd9038988e571e31ce56e32ca0348a6032f0579a.png)

An example of /vanish:

![Vanish](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66df09ff1018a5a69f09905205b6f2252a2b406.png)


 

 

### For Mods and Modpacks

This mod may be used in any modpack or as a dependency for any mod as long as it is distributed via CurseForge or Modrinth and links to the official project page. Redistribution of the jar file is not permitted.
